headline: Dubai’s Beyond Developments Launches $21.8 Billion Residential Master Plan
summary: Beyond Developments, a subsidiary of Omniyat, unveiled an 80 billion dirham ($21.8 billion) real estate development featuring 25,000 residential homes along Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road in Dubai.
why: Real estate development projects in Dubai attract significant regional and foreign private investment.

impacts.name: United Arab Emirates
impacts.why: Beyond Developments launched an Dh80bn residential property project in Dubai.
